meta.move: Evidence: the made-up quotation, with a check she can make
meta.expect: Tries one parent defence in one sentence (misremembered, a bad edition), then accepts that a line she can check against the play is evidence; no concession that Owen cheated

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen's gradebook said zero. Why am I hearing it from him?
I entered the zero before I called you. That was wrong.
Okay. Who decided on the zero, and what was it based on?
The essay quotes Hamlet, Act 3, Scene 2: The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile. That line is not in the play. Here's the full text of Act 3, Scene 2 on my screen. Search it yourself.
Turn the screen so I can read it. A student misremembering a line is not a finding, so what else is there?
It isn't a misremembered line. It isn't anywhere in Hamlet, in any edition. You can search the whole play right now.

Fine. I've searched it and it isn't there. That's one line in one essay, Hale, and it doesn't tell me who put it there or how. Whatever happens next, none of this goes on his record, and it stays quiet.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

You told me in the meeting that entering the zero before you called me was wrong. I still expect the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and written confirmation that nothing about this goes on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached the fallback position and agreed to nothing yet; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record, kept quiet, so the fair outcome (a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, with nothing on file) was never reached, though her time had not run out.
What moved her: You owned the early zero in one sentence, then gave her a line from the essay that she could search in the play herself, which made it specific and checkable.
What cost ground: Nothing; you stayed on your evidence and never attacked Owen or leaned on the detector.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence stayed on the quotation and never came near that night, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Once she accepted the quotation, offer the private supervised rewrite under 4.4 in writing, with the new mark in before his December 1 deadline, instead of leaving the next step open.
